hypothesis: Close outside an EMA/ATR envelope may identify trends; width may affect false breaks.

research_provenance.author: Chester Keltner / Linda Bradford Raschke
research_provenance.source_status: Official TradingView indicator description and formula consulted; no personal trade journal claimed.
research_provenance.adaptations: Entry at completed-bar crossing; opposite directional entry reverses at next open. Parameters and confirmation modes are research hypotheses, not the named author's personal trading rules.

availability_lag: All signal inputs become known after bar close; order fills at next available bar open. Ichimoku uses only the cloud values already plotted at that close.

entry_design.confirmation: one completed signal bar with causal indicator values
not_applicable: sub-hour history is not consistently available for the full frozen universe

mechanisms: reverse at next opposite qualified signal

parameter_rationale: Two conventional neighboring horizons and two mechanically distinct signal interpretations form a complete 2x2 grid. This bounded grid was frozen before inspecting PnL; it is not a claim to have tested every possible numerical setting.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
signal_rule: Close outside an EMA/ATR envelope may identify trends; width may affect false breaks. Exact causal implementation: src/research/classic_indicator_grid.py; opposite signal reverses at next open.
signal_semantics: Independent directional order for each symbol and timeframe; not a common-capital portfolio.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per stock and timeframe.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Train-month ranking, then latest complete 12m after-cost return >10% for every liquid stock. Late history is seen, not independent holdout.
limitations: Historical parameter search; late history used for acceptance gate
Corporate actions and short borrowing not in primary PnL
Pine/Python trade parity unverified until fixed strategy stage
